Prepare a shared gene-lollipop grid

Source: R/prepared-gene-lollipop.R
prepare_gene_lollipop.Rd

Selects native gene features and assigns a common, device-independent grid to all participating individuals. Empty cells remain reserved. Automatic ordinal copy correspondence is a display convention, not copy orthology.

Usage

prepare_gene_lollipop(
  x,
  name = "gene_lollipop",
  individuals = NULL,
  annotation = NULL,
  genes = NULL,
  where = NULL,
  key = NULL,
  homology = NULL,
  copy_key = NULL,
  reference = NULL,
  nrow = NULL,
  ncol = NULL,
  order = NULL,
  slots = NULL,
  label = NULL,
  fill = NULL
)

Arguments

x

A SynIndividual or SynSpecies.

name

Name of the prepared grid.

individuals

Optional participating individual IDs.

annotation

Optional source feature-annotation name; defaults to each individual's active feature annotation.

genes

Optional gene IDs/names, or a list named by individual.

where

Named list of metadata values. Alternatives within each field are combined with OR; different fields are combined with AND.

key

Optional metadata column identifying shared genes.

homology

Optional stored homology-annotation names. Explicit key and explicit homology cannot be combined.

copy_key

Optional metadata column identifying corresponding copies.

reference

Reference individual ID. Required for multiple individuals unless a unique common homology reference can be inferred.

nrow, ncol

Positive integer grid dimensions. Supply at least one.

order

Optional complete shared-key order, overriding reference/flanks.

slots

Optional partial table with shared_key, optional copy_id, head_row and head_col. Rows are numbered bottom to top.

label, fill

Optional source metadata columns. Defaults prefer nonempty plot_label and plot_fill, then gene names/IDs and grey fill.

Value

The updated Syn object. Inspect it with query_gene_lollipop().
